transmission: GM 4L70 or 4LHD automatic with torque converter (configuration dependent)
system_notes: Keep this model separate from the Power Stow 600i configuration. Confirm engine, transmission, and fuel configuration from the asset data plate. Configuration source: TUG Model 660-28 Operation Manual CD397-Oper, Operation-1-1 (PDF page 65) and Operation-3-8 (PDF page 100). The 660-28 is a belt loader per TUG Model 660-28 Operation Manual CD397-Oper, cover and §1.2 (PDF pages 1 and 65).

Power Stow Rollertrack installation covered by the Delta 740-774 document set. This is a distinct configuration, not an alias for the 660-28 row. Identify the base chassis and Power Stow serial numbers before service; do not inherit base-chassis engine, pressure, or electrical limits without a matching manual citation.
